items.raw_excerpt: Housing companies banning smoking are comparable to other rules on nighttime noise, according to the constitutional law committee's chair.
items.summary_en: A Finnish constitutional committee has ruled that housing companies can ban smoking in their buildings. The decision compares such bans to existing rules on nighttime noise.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드 헌법위원회는 주택 단지가 건물 내 흡연을 금지할 수 있다고 결정했습니다. 이번 결정은 흡연 금지 조치를 야간 소음 규정과 비슷한 것이라고 판단했습니다.
items.title_en: Finland committee allows smoking bans in housing
items.title_ko: 핀란드 헌법위원회, 주택 단지 흡연 금지 허용
items.title_original: No constitutional barrier to housing company smoking bans, committee finds

items.raw_excerpt: Rhodes University students in the Eastern Cape have embarked on a fees related protest.
items.summary_en: Students at Rhodes University in the Eastern Cape of South Africa started a protest. They are angry about a new protocol for how fees are handled. The protest is about money and rules for students.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카 동부 케이프의 로스대학교 학생들이 시위를 시작했다. 이들은 등록금을 다루는 새로운 규정에 반발하고 있다. 학생들 돈과 규정을 둘러싼 시위다.
items.title_en: Rhodes University Students Protest Over Fees Rules
items.title_ko: 로스대 학생들, 등록금 규정 두고 시위
items.title_original: Rhodes University students protest over fees protocol
